value: Every colour, type size, spacing step, radius and motion value lives in one token file, in light and dark, and its checker fails (exit 1) when a declared colour pair drops below WCAG AA in either theme.

howItWorks.title: One token file drives the page, and CI checks every colour pair

workflow: Copy tokens.json and its scripts into the repo, then swap the values for the product's own (brand-palette-roles when starting from brand colours).
Generate the CSS with tokens.mjs css --out tokens.css.
Run tokens.mjs check and fix every WCAG failure.
Load tokens.css before every other stylesheet, and add the pre-paint script so the stored theme applies before first paint.
